text: CI fails intermittently on PRs #103 and #104: snapshot::tests::a_locked_snapshot_refuses_edits_and_commits_and_keeps_head_and_tree panics at crates/athena-git/src/snapshot.rs:544 because the second lock() returns Spawn(NotFound, 'No such file or directory'); the same commit passes on the other CI run. Find and fix the cause of the flake.
